
```{r}
################################################################################
# Build_GMT.R - build a GMT for GSEA/ssGSEA in two sections, run separately:
#
#   SECTION 1 generates pathway_list.csv from gmt_whitelist.txt/gmt_blacklist.txt.
#   -> Run this chunk, then open pathway_list.csv and edit it directly: flip
#      `include` to FALSE, delete rows, or add a row for any exact MSigDB
#      gs_name you know isn't caught by any whitelist pattern.
#
#   SECTION 2 reads pathway_list.csv (not the whitelist/blacklist files) and
#   builds the actual GMT from whatever rows have include=TRUE - both a single
#   joint GMT and a folder of one-GMT-per-pathway (Out_dir/gmt/individual/).
#   If you add a row by hand with just include + gs_name, Section 2 backfills
#   gs_cat/gs_subcat/n_genes/gs_description for that row from msigdbr and
#   writes it back into pathway_list.csv - only blank cells get filled in.
#   -> Run this chunk after you're done editing the CSV.
#
# Re-running Section 1 does NOT overwrite an existing pathway_list.csv - it
# writes pathway_list_draft.csv instead, so manual edits are never silently
# clobbered by a re-generation. Diff the two and merge by hand if you want to
# pull in whitelist/blacklist changes without losing manual edits.
################################################################################

library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr)

#-----------------------------#
# CONFIG - shared by both sections
#-----------------------------#

species        <- "Homo sapiens"   # anything msigdbr supports, e.g. "Mus musculus"
base_dir       <- "F:/Navin/Utilities/GMT_Builder"   # folder holding this script + the note files
whitelist_file <- file.path(base_dir, "gmt_whitelist.txt")
blacklist_file <- file.path(base_dir, "gmt_blacklist.txt")
pathway_csv    <- file.path(base_dir, "pathway_list.csv")
Out_dir        <- file.path(base_dir, "output")   # local by default - point this at a project's own output folder if needed
out_name       <- "custom_geneset.gmt"

min_set_size   <- 10    # drop gene sets smaller than this (after gene mapping) - Section 1 only
max_set_size   <- 250   # drop gene sets larger than this (too broad to be useful) - Section 1 only

# Collection-level allow/block, applied BEFORE the biological whitelist/blacklist
# text files - matches white-black-list.rmd's allowed_patterns/blocked_patterns,
# checked against gs_cat combined with gs_subcat (e.g. "C2:CP:REACTOME"). Kept
# here as script config rather than a third note file since this changes rarely
# (it's what collections exist at all, not which pathways within them matter).
collection_whitelist_patterns <- c(
  "^H$",
  "^C2:CP:REACTOME",
  "^C2:CP:KEGG",
  "^C2:CP:WIKIPATHWAYS",
  "MEDICUS"
)
collection_blacklist_patterns <- c(
  "GO:CC",
  "MIR",
  "TFT"
)

# msigdbr renamed gs_cat/gs_subcat -> gs_collection/gs_subcollection in a recent
# major version - this resolves whichever names the installed version actually
# uses instead of hardcoding one, so the script works either way.
resolve_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) {
    stop(
      "None of these columns found in msigdbr output: ", paste(candidates, collapse = ", "),
      ". Installed msigdbr's columns are: ", paste(names(df), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  hit[1]
}

fetch_msigdbr <- function(species, with_metadata = TRUE) {
  raw <- msigdbr(species = species)
  name_col <- resolve_col(raw, c("gs_name"))
  gene_col <- resolve_col(raw, c("gene_symbol"))
  if (!with_metadata) {
    out <- raw[, c(name_col, gene_col)]
    names(out) <- c("gs_name", "gene_symbol")
    return(dplyr::distinct(out))
  }
  cat_col  <- resolve_col(raw, c("gs_cat", "gs_collection"))
  subcat_col <- resolve_col(raw, c("gs_subcat", "gs_subcollection"))
  desc_col <- resolve_col(raw, c("gs_description"))
  out <- raw[, c(name_col, cat_col, subcat_col, desc_col, gene_col)]
  names(out) <- c("gs_name", "gs_cat", "gs_subcat", "gs_description", "gene_symbol")
  out <- dplyr::distinct(out)
  # "collection" string like the original's master CSV, e.g. "H" or "C2:CP:REACTOME"
  out$collection <- ifelse(nzchar(out$gs_subcat), paste(out$gs_cat, out$gs_subcat, sep = ":"), out$gs_cat)
  out
}
```

## Section 1 - build pathway_list.csv from the whitelist/blacklist

```{r}
read_patterns <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Pattern file not found: ", path)
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  lines <- trimws(lines)
  lines[nzchar(lines) & !startsWith(lines, "#")]
}

whitelist_patterns <- read_patterns(whitelist_file)
blacklist_patterns <- read_patterns(blacklist_file)

if (length(whitelist_patterns) == 0) {
  stop("Whitelist is empty - nothing would be included. Add at least one pattern to ", whitelist_file)
}

whitelist_regex <- paste(whitelist_patterns, collapse = "|")
blacklist_regex <- if (length(blacklist_patterns) > 0) paste(blacklist_patterns, collapse = "|") else NA

# pull the full msigdbr table (all collections) for the species
all_sets <- fetch_msigdbr(species, with_metadata = TRUE)

# collection-level allow/block first (which collections exist at all)
collection_whitelist_regex <- paste(collection_whitelist_patterns, collapse = "|")
collection_blacklist_regex <- paste(collection_blacklist_patterns, collapse = "|")

before_collection_names <- unique(all_sets$gs_name)

kept <- all_sets %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl(collection_whitelist_regex, collection, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl(collection_blacklist_regex, collection, ignore.case = TRUE))

dropped_by_collection <- length(before_collection_names) - length(unique(kept$gs_name))

# then biological whitelist, then biological blacklist (blacklist always wins)
kept <- kept %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl(whitelist_regex, gs_name, ignore.case = TRUE))

matched_whitelist_names <- unique(kept$gs_name)

if (!is.na(blacklist_regex)) {
  before_names <- unique(kept$gs_name)
  kept <- kept %>%
    dplyr::filter(!grepl(blacklist_regex, gs_name, ignore.case = TRUE))
  dropped_by_blacklist <- setdiff(before_names, unique(kept$gs_name))
} else {
  dropped_by_blacklist <- character(0)
}

# size filter
before_size_names <- unique(kept$gs_name)

kept <- kept %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gs_name) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() >= min_set_size, dplyr::n() <= max_set_size) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

dropped_by_size <- setdiff(before_size_names, unique(kept$gs_name))

# build the pathway list
matched_pattern_for <- function(name) {
  hits <- whitelist_patterns[vapply(whitelist_patterns, function(p) grepl(p, name, ignore.case = TRUE), logical(1))]
  paste(hits, collapse = "; ")
}

pathway_list <- kept %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gs_name, gs_cat, gs_subcat, gs_description) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(gene_symbol), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(gs_cat, gs_subcat, gs_name) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    include = TRUE,
    matched_whitelist_pattern = vapply(gs_name, matched_pattern_for, character(1)),
    notes = ""   # free-text space for manual annotation, never touched by this script
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(include, gs_name, gs_cat, gs_subcat, n_genes, matched_whitelist_pattern, gs_description, notes)

# write - never clobber manual edits
if (file.exists(pathway_csv)) {
  out_csv <- file.path(base_dir, "pathway_list_draft.csv")
  message("NOTE: ", pathway_csv, " already exists - not overwriting it (it may hold manual edits).")
  message("Writing the fresh draft to ", out_csv, " instead - review/merge by hand if you want the changes.")
} else {
  out_csv <- pathway_csv
}

utils::write.csv(pathway_list, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)

# summary
unmatched_patterns <- whitelist_patterns[
  !vapply(whitelist_patterns, function(p) any(grepl(p, matched_whitelist_names, ignore.case = TRUE)), logical(1))
]

message("Wrote: ", out_csv)
message("Gene sets included: ", nrow(pathway_list))
message("Gene sets dropped by collection allow/block list: ", dropped_by_collection)
message("Gene sets dropped by blacklist: ", length(dropped_by_blacklist))
if (length(dropped_by_blacklist) > 0) message("  - ", paste(dropped_by_blacklist, collapse = ", "))
message("Gene sets dropped by size filter (<", min_set_size, " or >", max_set_size, " genes): ", length(dropped_by_size))
if (length(dropped_by_size) > 0) message("  - ", paste(dropped_by_size, collapse = ", "))
if (length(unmatched_patterns) > 0) {
  message("Whitelist patterns that matched NOTHING (check for typos): ", paste(unmatched_patterns, collapse = ", "))
}
message("")
message("Next: open ", out_csv, ", edit `include` / add / delete rows as needed (a new row only needs")
message("include + gs_name filled in - Section 2 backfills the rest), then run Section 2 below.")
```

## Section 2 - build the GMT from pathway_list.csv

```{r}
if (!file.exists(pathway_csv)) {
  stop("Pathway list not found: ", pathway_csv, " - run Section 1 first.")
}

pathway_list_final <- utils::read.csv(pathway_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

if (!all(c("include", "gs_name") %in% names(pathway_list_final))) {
  stop("pathway_list.csv must have at least an 'include' and a 'gs_name' column.")
}

included_names <- pathway_list_final$gs_name[as.logical(pathway_list_final$include)]
included_names <- unique(trimws(included_names))
included_names <- included_names[nzchar(included_names)]

if (length(included_names) == 0) {
  stop("No rows with include=TRUE in ", pathway_csv)
}

# re-fetch gene membership (+ metadata, for backfill below) for exactly the
# included gene sets - the CSV only carries metadata, not the gene list, so
# this reflects any manual add/delete
all_sets_final <- fetch_msigdbr(species, with_metadata = TRUE)

final_kept <- all_sets_final %>%
  dplyr::filter(gs_name %in% included_names)

found_names <- unique(final_kept$gs_name)
not_found <- setdiff(included_names, found_names)

#-----------------------------#
# BACKFILL metadata for rows that only have include/gs_name filled in - e.g. a
# pathway you added by hand and didn't look up gs_cat/n_genes/description for
# yourself. Only touches blank/NA cells - anything already filled in (or a
# manual `notes` entry) is left exactly as-is.
#-----------------------------#

for (col in c("gs_cat", "gs_subcat", "n_genes", "gs_description", "notes")) {
  if (!col %in% names(pathway_list_final)) pathway_list_final[[col]] <- NA
}

meta_lookup  <- dplyr::distinct(final_kept, gs_name, gs_cat, gs_subcat, gs_description)
gene_counts  <- final_kept %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gs_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_genes_actual = dplyr::n_distinct(gene_symbol), .groups = "drop")

is_blank <- function(x) is.na(x) | !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))

need_meta <- is_blank(pathway_list_final$gs_cat)
need_n    <- is_blank(pathway_list_final$n_genes)

if (any(need_meta) || any(need_n)) {
  meta_idx <- match(pathway_list_final$gs_name, meta_lookup$gs_name)
  n_idx    <- match(pathway_list_final$gs_name, gene_counts$gs_name)

  pathway_list_final$gs_cat[need_meta]         <- meta_lookup$gs_cat[meta_idx[need_meta]]
  pathway_list_final$gs_subcat[need_meta]      <- meta_lookup$gs_subcat[meta_idx[need_meta]]
  pathway_list_final$gs_description[need_meta] <- meta_lookup$gs_description[meta_idx[need_meta]]
  pathway_list_final$n_genes[need_n]           <- gene_counts$n_genes_actual[n_idx[need_n]]

  backfilled <- unique(pathway_list_final$gs_name[need_meta | need_n])
  utils::write.csv(pathway_list_final, pathway_csv, row.names = FALSE)
  message("Backfilled metadata for manually-added row(s) and updated ", pathway_csv, ": ", paste(backfilled, collapse = ", "))
}

write_gmt <- function(df, file) {
  gmt_list <- split(df$gene_symbol, df$gs_name)
  con <- file(file, "w")
  for (gs in names(gmt_list)) {
    genes <- unique(gmt_list[[gs]])
    line <- c(gs, "na", genes)
    writeLines(paste(line, collapse = "\t"), con)
  }
  close(con)
}

dir.create(Out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
gmt_dir <- file.path(Out_dir, "gmt")
dir.create(gmt_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
out_path <- file.path(gmt_dir, out_name)

write_gmt(final_kept, out_path)

# individual per-pathway GMTs, one file per included gene set - same content
# as the joint file, just split out for tools that expect one pathway per file
individual_dir <- file.path(gmt_dir, "individual")
dir.create(individual_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

sanitize_filename <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]", "_", x)

for (gs in found_names) {
  write_gmt(
    final_kept[final_kept$gs_name == gs, ],
    file.path(individual_dir, paste0(sanitize_filename(gs), ".gmt"))
  )
}

message("Wrote: ", out_path)
message("Wrote ", length(found_names), " individual GMTs to: ", individual_dir)
message("Gene sets included: ", length(found_names), " of ", length(included_names), " rows marked include=TRUE")
if (length(not_found) > 0) {
  message("NOT FOUND in msigdbr for species '", species, "' (typo, wrong species, or renamed set) - check these rows in ", pathway_csv, ":")
  message("  - ", paste(not_found, collapse = ", "))
}

################################################################################
# DONE
################################################################################
```
